# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite GPU backend preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the new Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn on Skia m152. This preview also fixes several native use-after-free and memory-leak bugs, and adds backend-neutral async pixel readback.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to Chrome milestone 152** — SkiaSharp now tracks Skia m152, with upstream m151 stability fixes merged along the way. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain an async RequestReadPixels API that works consistently across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed native use-after-free and memory-leak bugs** — SKRegion.SpanIterator, SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, and SKImage.Create's raster failure path no longer leave dangling native memory or leak a CoTaskMem pixel buffer. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Nano Server font support restored** — Nano Server now uses FreeType for font support. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Reduced allocations in hot paths** — Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, avoids the double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, and pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release with no API changes.
